## Summary of PR/Issue
- Issue #275 identified that explicit `/implement` requests made from a PR could ask for stacked work but still create the follow-up PR against `main`.
- The maintainer clarified that the desired fix was to reuse the existing implement metadata prompt rather than add deterministic request-text parsing.
- PR #280 extends that metadata contract with optional positive-integer `base_pr`, validates and carries it through dispatch outputs, and passes it into `agent-implement.yml`.
- The PR also updates prompt/docs coverage and adds targeted parser, CLI, and workflow envelope tests.

@sepo-agent /answer double check it only sets base_pr but not base_branch at the same time?

Yes. In PR #280’s explicit `/implement` path, it only populates `base_pr`; it does **not** also set `base_branch` non-empty.

Evidence:
- `agent-router.yml` exposes `base_pr` and passes only `BASE_PR` into `dispatch-agent-implement`; there is no `BASE_BRANCH` env added there: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/829794804070ae9aadfbe439d5aea2dc1478403f/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L129 and https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/829794804070ae9aadfbe439d5aea2dc1478403f/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L694-L706
- `dispatch-agent-implement.ts` always sends both input keys, but `base_branch` comes from `process.env.BASE_BRANCH || ""`, so on this path it is an empty string while `base_pr` carries the value: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/829794804070ae9aadfbe439d5aea2dc1478403f/.agent/src/cli/dispatch-agent-implement.ts#L17-L35
- The implement workflow resolver still guards the invariant: if both are non-empty, it errors with `set only one of base_branch or base_pr`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/829794804070ae9aadfbe439d5aea2dc1478403f/.agent/src/implementation-base.ts#L58-L64

One nuance: after `base_pr` is accepted, the implementation workflow resolves that PR to its head branch and exports runtime `BASE_BRANCH` for checkout/fetch. That is expected and happens after the mutual-exclusion check; it is not setting the dispatch input `base_branch` alongside `base_pr`.

Small test gap: the PR tests `base_pr` propagation/validation, but I don’t see a focused assertion that the explicit dispatch payload’s `base_branch` is empty when `base_pr` is set. The code path looks correct; adding that assertion would make the invariant explicit.

## Rubrics Update

Updated [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #280.

Updated one existing rubric, no new duplicate rubric added.

Changed `rubrics/workflow/context-derived-artifact-metadata.yaml` to cover context-derived dispatch metadata as well as tracking artifact metadata, with provenance from the maintainer’s issue comment on #275. This captures the durable preference from PR #280’s context: extend existing metadata contracts with typed validated fields instead of adding ad hoc request parsers.

Validation: `node .agent/dist/cli/rubrics/validate.js` passed for all 24 rubrics.
